subject: lavaan ERROR: linear regression failed for marsu; X may not be of full rank in group 1

messages.author: 4bfae3793264e847
messages.subject: lavaan ERROR: linear regression failed for marsu; X may not be of full rank in group 1
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to fit the following model:

data2[,c("tryp.inf0",
        "n4.5.7",
        "n1.2",
        "n15.29",
        "hepaci.inf",
        "picorna",
        "picobirna")] <-
  lapply(data2[,c("tryp.inf0",
                 "n4.5.7",
                 "n1.2",
                 "n15.29",
                 "hepaci.inf",
                 "picorna",
                 "picobirna")], ordered)



model11 = "#regressions
tryp.inf0 ~ supertype.richness + supertype3x1

n4.5.7 ~ supertype.richness

n1.2 ~ Chao1.10.0 + supertype3x1

n15.29 ~ landscapeforest.fragment + landscapeisland + juliDensity + Chao1.10.0 + supertype1x1

picorna ~ 0*landscapeforest.fragment + landscapeisland + juliDensity + supertype2x1 + supertype4x1 + supertype7x1 + supertype9x1

picobirna ~ marsu

hepaci.inf ~ landscapeforest.fragment + landscapeisland + sexM + supertype1x1

multi.inf ~ marsu

n4.5.7.per.g ~ landscape + supertype12x1

n1.2.per.g ~ landscape + marsu + supertype9x1

n15.29.per.g ~ landscape + marsu

Chao1.10.0 ~ landscapeforest.fragment + landscapeisland

juliDensity ~ landscapeforest.fragment + landscapeisland + Chao1.10.0

marsu ~ landscapeforest.fragment + landscapeisland"

model11.sem = sem(model11, data2, estimator = "WLSMV")
summary(model11.sem, standardize = TRUE)

and get the following error message:

Error in lav_samplestats_step1(Y = Data, ov.names = ov.names, ov.types = ov.types,  : 
  lavaan ERROR: linear regression failed for multi.inf; X may not be of full rank in group 1

What does it mean that "X may not be of full rank in group 1"? Missing values? There aren't any NA's in my dataset.

If I stepwise delete the regressions that apparently cause the error message I get the Warning:

1: In muthen1984(Data = X[[g]], ov.names = ov.names[[g]], ov.types = ov.types,  :
  lavaan WARNING: trouble constructing W matrix; used generalized inverse for A11 submatrix
2: In lavaan::lavaan(model = model11, data = data2, estimator = "WLSMV",  :
  lavaan WARNING: model has NOT converged!

Any help would be greatly appreciated!

Julian

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: lavaan ERROR: linear regression failed for marsu; X may not be of full rank in group 1
parts:
>   lavaan ERROR: linear regression failed for multi.inf; X may not be of
> full rank in group 1

> What does it mean that "X may not be of full rank in group 1"? Missing
> values? There aren't any NA's in my dataset.

X is (here) the matrix of all exogenous covariates; in your case:

PT <- lavaanify(model11)
lavNames(PT, "ov.x")

gives

[1] "supertype.richness" "supertype3x1"
[3] "landscapeforest.fragment" "landscapeisland"
[5] "supertype1x1" "supertype2x1"
[7] "supertype4x1" "supertype7x1"
[9] "supertype9x1" "sexM"
[11] "landscape" "supertype12x1"

One of these variables can be written as a linear combination of others.
You need to find it, and remove it from your model.

Yves.
